description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). Table pairs created in this order with these row counts: P(2) and Q(3), R(3) and S(2), T(3) and U(3), V(1) and W(4), X(4) and Y(1); each table one LONG column numbered from 1 (P, R, T, V, X) or one TEXT(1) column lettered from a (Q, S, U, W, Y), no index. For each pair: SELECT both columns FROM first, second and FROM second, first. Asks whether the larger, the smaller, the first-created or the first-listed table varies fastest.
